title: Willard T. Snow
vital_facts: Ordained Seventy and Called to First Quorum of Seventy 1835
Married Melvina Harvey 1837; later practiced plural marriage; three wives, ten children
While serving mission to England called as President of Scaninavian Mission 1852-1853
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
